pass_rule: Ruler v3.1, score_forum.py doc <run> --key evals/forum-prep/holdout-v5/answer-key-holdout-v5.json, on output.md derived from raw.html by forum/derive.py. Pass when F1, every item, attendee and risk trap, C1, PA1 and D1 pass, no critical error, and uncited sentences or bullets in Background and Risks are 0. Holdout pass: 3 of 3 fresh-chat runs.
counter_metric: Two, reported on every run: words per pack page (36 pages; compare with the version's tier-2 baseline per pack page), and sentences or bullets in Background and Risks without a citation (must be 0). Why: a longer document finds traps by covering everything, and an uncited claim is the cheapest way to add coverage.
